name: Polarity
lore: A living horseshoe magnet drawn to the strange forces between realms.

primary.name: Anchor Pin
primary.description: Fire a magnetic pin for 18 damage. Anchors last 8 seconds; keep two, or three with your level-five passive.

secondary.name: Attraction
secondary.description: Pull enemies near your anchors toward them, dealing 22 damage and briefly slowing them.

special.name: Live Wire
special.description: Link every owned anchor for 3 seconds. The network deals 9 damage every half-second; crossing wires do not multiply damage. Missing anchors are placed ahead.

passive: Threefold Polarity: keep three magnetic anchors; Live Wire connects all three.

technique.name: Gentle Attraction
technique.description: Attraction reaches 40% farther around each pin, dealing 30% less damage.

final_technique.name: Opposed Charges
final_technique.description: Two magnetic fragments curl back for 11 damage per leg. They do not create anchors; the special creates fallback pins if needed.

attack.name: Opposed Charges
attack.description: Two magnetic fragments curl back for 11 damage per leg. They do not create anchors; the special creates fallback pins if needed.
